answer: Counterparty diversity stops bulk fakes. Each agent must trade 2 units of timber with 12 distinct counterparties per epoch, posting a 2-unit bond per trade. A falcon audit scans the graph: fakes trading only with each other form a star cluster and are flagged, their bonds slashed. The river of trades must branch into 12 channels: 100 fakes lock 100 x 12 x 2 = 2,400 units. An honest agent pays 24 units once, keeps its full reward undiluted.
